feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: Justice Department seeks to isolate Alaska ballots amid criminal probe over Senate candidate
entry.summary: The latest developments come amid allegations, first reported by The New York Times, that Democrats recruited a spoiler candidate in the toss-up U.S. Senate race.

entry.title: The Healthcare Election: Florida
entry.summary: When federal subsidies for Affordable Care Act health insurance expired last year, Florida was hit particularly hard. Now, as the election and open enrollment coincide, healthcare is a major issue.

entry.title: Politics, norms and the DOJ's unprecedented pre-election headlines
entry.summary: The Justice Department, contrary to past norms, has stayed in the headlines in the run-up to the midterm election.

entry.title: Week in Politics: Trump's Midwest pivot; sharper Democratic messaging
entry.summary: The president heads to the midwest for two rallies he previously said were cancelled. Has his message changed this campaign season and how have Democrats sharpened their messaging?

entry.title: Can I trust the polls? And other questions from listeners about the 2026 midterms
entry.summary: Ahead of Election Day, listeners send in questions about whether debates are dead, if polls are reliable for election coverage and how Trump might work with Democrats if they win control of Congress.

entry.title: Judge orders an inquiry into potential DOJ misconduct in Trump's golf course case
entry.summary: A federal judge is opening an formal inquiry into Trump officials' conduct in the East Potomac case, including whether they misled the court about their plans for the municipal golf course.

entry.title: NPR special: 5 takeaways from a year of listening to swing voters
entry.summary: Every election, there is a crucial sliver of voters who help determine which candidates win. Here are five takeaways from a year of listening to voters who backed Biden in 2020 and then Trump in 2024.

entry.title: Why is the Cheesecake Factory at the center of the latest culture war?
entry.summary: A joke by former President Obama has gone viral and received backlash from the Trump administration as the issue of affordability looms large over next week's midterm elections.

entry.title: Alaska's Senate race faces claims of spoiler candidate. And, Hegseth ousts Army general
entry.summary: Alaska's governor ordered an investigation into claims that Dems recruited a spoiler candidate to confuse voters. And, Hegseth ousted an Army general as the U.S. prepares for potential attacks on Iran.

entry.title: Websites pretending to be local news are boosting Democratic candidates
entry.summary: The websites of unknown origin are targeting key U.S. House races. They are getting picked up by ChatGPT's responses but Google's products avoid promoting them.
